title: Align closing-baseline handling of acknowledged legacy FULL lint-stage records
outcome: Closing-baseline and received-check notice behavior is defined for an already acknowledged legacy FULL body classified by the old clippy/docs stage rules. Use the same host-digest-bound historical reconstruction as settlement and acceptance if the closing policy supports it, or document the intentional fail-closed difference. Never mint new credit from a disk-only body or request label.
acceptance: A deterministic retained-body case exercises a host-acknowledged pre-change record whose clippy or docs stage was labeled Test and lacks independently recognized observed argv. It verifies the chosen closing-baseline and received-notice behavior, alongside the settlement and acceptance behavior.
Fresh or disk-only legacy-looking records still fail closed. Existing request, source, body digest and receipt checks remain enforced.
